changes: Author p1: confidence lowered to medium; 'mahā-' treated as an honorific prefix and 'bhatta' read as bhaṭṭa, so the stem is uncertain (Mudgala vs Mudgalabhaṭṭa)
Scribe p2: evidence shortened; the upanāma (Bhūmaṇḍana?) and the corrupt †naheraṃ† moved to notes; confidence stays high for 'Govinda'
Purpose rephrased as a dedication to Kālabhairava
Date: month normalised to āśvina; notes list possible CE years for Hemalamba, but ce_approx is left empty because the era and reckoning cannot be fixed
Notes expanded: the catalogue field 'Kāśī' is confirmed; '6' after 'rāma' is the folio number, not a date

notes: The year is given only as the saṃvatsara name Hemalamba (no era or numeral). In southern (luni-solar) reckoning Hemalamba falls in, for example, 1597/98, 1657/58, 1717/18, 1777/78, 1837/38, 1897/98 or 1957/58 CE. The weekday (Sunday, Āśvina śukla 9) could be used to pick one of these, but the cycle reckoning is uncertain, so ce_approx is left empty. The scribe's name is corrupt: 'goviṃda†naheraṃ† bhumaṃḍanetyupanāmakena' appears to give Govinda with the upanāma (surname) Bhūmaṇḍana (written 'bhumaṃḍana'). The cataloguer marks †naheraṃ† as corrupt; it may be part of the name or the surname. 'rāma || 6 ||' is the folio number. The catalogue fields (Scribe: Govinda; Place: Kāśī) match the colophon. The author's name is read as Mudgala(bhaṭṭa), with 'mahā-' taken as an honorific.
